description: List official DS2 starter and tutorial examples (basic, tutorial-basic, intermediate, xg5000-demo-kit, advanced, carwash, st-conditions-v2, robot-assembly-cell-v2) with localized titles and metadata. Filter results with optional query (alias q), category ('fixture', 'st-expression', 'legacy'), lang ('ko', 'en', 'de', 'ja'), or languageVersion ('ds2/v2', 'ds2/v1'). Use to discover available example IDs before fetching full .ds2 source with dsdx.examples.get; use docs_search for reference specifications.

query.description: Optional keyword filter across id, alias, and title
